Markets.title: Lumino Industries shares soar 40% from IPO price after strong market debut. Should you buy or wait?
Markets.summary: Lumino Industries shares surged 40% above their IPO price following a strong market debut driven by attractive valuations, profitability, and debt reduction. Analysts advise new investors to wait for price consolidation, while existing allottees are recommended to book partial profits.

Markets.title: Nominal GDP growth set to surge to 12%. Why the stock market may still struggle to rally
Markets.summary: India's nominal GDP growth is projected to reach 11.5% to 12% in fiscal year 2027, which should support stronger corporate earnings. However, high valuations and increased equity supply may prevent a broad stock market rally, leading analysts to favor selective sectors like lenders, power, ports, and real estate.

Markets.title: Global Market: China stocks rebound as investors await US jobs data, domestic economic indicators
Markets.summary: Mainland Chinese stocks rebounded, led by property shares as investors awaited key US jobs data and domestic economic indicators. Meanwhile, Hong Kong markets remained flat while Beijing pledged continued efforts to boost domestic demand.

Markets.title: IFCI shares rally over 16% in two days as NSE IPO draws closer
Markets.summary: IFCI shares surged over 16% in two sessions due to growing expectations that the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) is closer to launching its long-delayed IPO. IFCI benefits from the potential offering because it indirectly owns more than 4% of the NSE through its stake in the Stock Holding Corporation of India.

Markets.title: Trump’s second-term policies put US finances under growing strain as debt tops $40 trillion
Markets.summary: During Trump's presidency, the U.S. national debt surpassed $40 trillion due to climbing federal spending, steep interest rates, and administration tax cuts. This fiscal strain builds upon a trajectory of financial decline that began well before Trump took office.

Markets.title: HUDCO shares jump 4% after signing Rs 25,000 crore MoU with Bihar government for infrastructure development
Markets.summary: HUDCO shares rose almost 4% following a newly signed memorandum of understanding to provide up to Rs 25,000 crore in financial assistance to the Bihar government for infrastructure development over five years. This agreement follows a separate Rs 1 lakh crore MoU signed with Bihar in July for urban infrastructure projects.

Geo-Political.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
Geo-Political.summary: The World Meteorological Organization warns that a severe El Niño weather event could disrupt global economies. Countries are currently preparing for the expected impacts of this natural phenomenon.

Geo-Political.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation has found that a shortage of small boats is forcing once-rival Channel smuggling gangs to work together. As crackdowns limit the supply of standard vessels, these criminal groups are now resorting to the use of "mega-dinghies."

Geo-Political.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
Geo-Political.summary: Saudi Arabia reported that an Iranian attack on a Saudi oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz killed two Filipino sailors. The kingdom condemned the strike, which involved projectiles hitting the vessel on Monday.

Geo-Political.title: Could Lindsay Clancy trial end in a mistrial? Here are the jury's options
Geo-Political.summary: Jurors in the trial of Lindsay Clancy face five potential options as they decide her fate for the murder of her three children. These options will determine whether the trial concludes with a verdict or results in a mistrial.

Geo-Political.title: Trump $1 coin makes him first living president on US currency in a century
Geo-Political.summary: The US Mint is releasing a special edition $1 coin featuring a portrait of Donald Trump. This makes him the first living US president to appear on American currency in a century.

Geo-Political.title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of orchestrating murder of renowned journalist
Geo-Political.summary: A Maltese tycoon has been acquitted of orchestrating the 2017 car bomb murder of investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Caruana Galizia was killed after exposing corruption and money laundering schemes in Malta.

Data & Insights.title: India’s services sector expands in August, but growth at four-year low, PMI survey shows
Data & Insights.summary: India's services sector continued to expand in August, though overall growth reached a four-year low due to weak new-business growth and intense competition. Meanwhile, hiring within the sector reached a 15-month high during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Who is Subhash Chandra Garg? All about ex‑finance secretary questioning India’s 7.8% GDP growth
Data & Insights.summary: Subhash Chandra Garg is a former Indian finance secretary who took voluntary retirement in July 2019, months before his scheduled departure in October 2020. His early exit followed a bureaucratic reshuffle that moved him to the Power Ministry just three weeks after the Union Budget was presented.

Data & Insights.title: Centre defends GDP estimates, says revisions reflect updated data, methodology
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government defended its latest GDP estimates, denying allegations that it artificially inflated the June quarter's real growth rate to 7.8% and nominal expansion to 10.3%. Officials stated that the revisions were based on updated data and improved methodologies rather than manipulation.

Data & Insights.title: BJP Vs Congress: ‘Not comparing apples with apples?’ Piyush Goyal hits back at Congress criticism of GDP numbers
Data & Insights.summary: India's economy grew faster than expected despite concerns over the US-Iran war. In response to Congress criticism of these figures, BJP leader Piyush Goyal defended the data.

Data & Insights.title: How a stalled mall in Srinagar fetched a massive amount in auction - more than double govt expectation
Data & Insights.summary: An abandoned mall land parcel in Srinagar was successfully auctioned for a record ₹421.75 crore on a full-lease basis. The final winning bid, achieved after an overnight bidding session, was more than double the government's initial expectation.

Data & Insights.title: '7.8% growth but still import-dependent': Sridhar Vembu explains Modi’s Swadeshi push
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India revised its fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.7%, while Prime Minister Modi highlighted a 7.8% real GDP growth in the first quarter. Emphasizing the country's continued import dependence, Modi urged citizens to boost local consumption and avoid non-essential spending to conserve foreign exchange.

India.title: Pilot Felt Unwell Mid-Air, Doha-Bengaluru IndiGo Flight Diverts To Muscat
India.summary: An IndiGo flight from Doha to Bengaluru safely diverted to Muscat after the pilot felt unwell mid-air. The pilot received medical attention upon landing, was taken to a hospital, and is now fine.

India.title: Woman Stabbed To Death By Lover At Delhi Hotel, Accused Attempts Suicide
India.summary: A woman was stabbed to death by her boyfriend at a hotel in Delhi's Lahori Gate area. Following the attack, the accused attempted suicide by consuming poison.

India.title: Vijay Steps On Formula 1 Gas, Announces Mega Olympic City In Chennai
India.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay has announced plans to build an Olympic City in Chennai. He stated that the project will also include world-class motor racing arenas to boost tourism, employment, and the auto manufacturing industry.

India.title: When Will NEET PG 2026 Result Be Released? Check Expected Date And Time
India.summary: The NEET PG 2026 results are expected to be released by September 30. Students can check the expected date, exam details, and download steps on the official website.

India.title: Court Setback For MK Stalin Over Poll Defeat In Stronghold Kolathur
India.summary: TVK candidate VS Babu defeated MK Stalin by 8,795 votes in the Kolathur constituency. This ended Stalin's winning streak in the stronghold he had held since 2011.

India.title: Two Days To Go For National Teachers Award 2026: Check Complete List
India.summary: The Ministry of Education's Department of School Education and Literacy organizes a national-level awards ceremony on Teachers' Day each September 5. The complete list of winners for the upcoming National Teachers' Award 2026 will be released in two days.

General.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply

General.summary: A BBC investigation reveals that human smuggling gangs are running low on small boats. As a result, rival gangs are now cooperating and packing more migrants onto larger vessels.

General.summary: The World Meteorological Organization warns that a major El Niño weather phenomenon is forming. This event could cause widespread disruptions to economies around the world.

General.title: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
General.summary: King Charles is praising an unprecedented exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry in London. British and French leaders will visit the British Museum to view the historic artwork.

General.title: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
General.summary: Uber has launched the UK's first fleet of 15 self-driving taxis in London. These vehicles currently feature safety drivers seated inside during rides.
